_comment: Shared by core/src/access/pass.rs (cargo test) and deploy/public-edge/verify-edge.sh. KEY is the hex-looking string used AS IS as the HMAC key (its text bytes). mac = unpadded base64url(HMAC-SHA256(KEY, 'dev|<id>|<issued>')) for a pass and 'inv|<name>|<expiry>' for a legacy invite. Regenerate with openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac KEY -binary | base64 -w0 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='.
